flag provided but not defined: -bogus symbrain memory sync — synchronize the embedded memory store with a remote Usage: symbrain memory sync --remote [flags] Flags: --remote Base URL of the remote memory server (required). Must use https, except http://localhost or 127.0.0.1 for local development. --pull Only pull remote changes into the local database. --push Only push local changes to the remote server. (With neither flag, both directions run.) --token Bearer token for the remote API. May come from $SYMBRAIN_MEMORY_SYNC_TOKEN instead; never pass it on the command line in shared shells. --encrypted-relay Exchange client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted blobs through the remote /api/sync/relay endpoint, so the relay never sees plaintext memory content. --relay-passphrase

Passphrase for --encrypted-relay. May come from $SYMBRAIN_MEMORY_SYNC_RELAY_PASSPHRASE instead. Both peers must share it. --allow-insecure-http Override the https requirement for non-loopback remotes. Bearer tokens will be sent in the clear; a WARNING is printed. Use only for testing. --db Database path override (default: the standard memory database under the XDG data directory). --timeout Per-run HTTP timeout (default 60s). The local database and its per-remote sync cursors are reused in place; no export or import step is needed.
